subject: Search Performance Degradation — Incident Post-Mortem
body:
Hi team,

Posting the post-mortem for the search performance degradation incident that occurred November 10, 2024.

Timeline:
- 14:30 IST: Users report search queries timing out
- 14:45 IST: On-call (Riya Desai) alerted via PagerDuty
- 15:10 IST: Root cause identified — missing index on the documents.created_at column
- 15:45 IST: Hotfix applied (ticket NEX-244), index created online, performance restored
- 16:00 IST: All clear

Root cause: The database migration on Nov 3 (NEX-189) ran successfully, but the post-migration index rebuild script had an error that caused the created_at index to be dropped and not recreated. See PR #52 for the hotfix.

Action items:
1. Add index verification step to migration runbook — Diana Chen — by Nov 19
2. Add automated index health checks to monitoring pipeline — Kenji Nakamura — by Nov 22
3. Review all migration scripts for similar omissions — Arjun Mehta — by Nov 20

Full post-mortem doc: docs/incident-postmortem-nov10.md

Riya Desai
Software Engineer
